messages:
elaine: @jordan quick sync on the POC staging sandbox — we need to lock down sample data delivery, redaction rules, and network path. Can you confirm what you can share and whether presigned S3 PUTs are acceptable?

jordan: we can provide ~5k rows (CSV). we'll strip full names but need to keep dates and internal IDs. absolutely no SSNs or full emails. presigned PUTs preferred. we also need an automated validator to ensure nothing sensitive slips through.

mike: presigned PUTs work. options: 1) you upload to our staging bucket via presigned PUT; 2) we assume a short-lived cross-account role and pull from your S3. presigned is simplest. example for GET presign: `aws s3 presign s3://bucket/key --expires-in 3600` but we'll hand you a pre-signed PUT URL. we'll run a checksum post-upload.

sophia: networking notes: for a hosted sandbox, HTTPS over the public internet + IP allowlist for callbacks is typical. if you need VPC-only access we can do VPC peering or set up an S3 VPC endpoint and restrict access. KMS: hosted uses Redwood KMS; Private deployments can use customer-managed CMKs.

jordan: IP allowlist + presigned PUTs sounds good. what's the redaction validator look like? need it to catch PHI, SSNs, CC numbers.

mike: we'll run a two-stage validator: regex checks for SSN/CC/email and a small NER model for PHI. validator will return a report and block ingestion if critical finds exist. sample endpoint:```\ncurl -X POST -F "file=@sampledb.csv" https://staging.redwood.ai/validate -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>"\n```returns JSON with counts and flagged rows. we'll also provide the exact regex list so you can pre-sanitize.

elaine: proposed POC success criteria (please confirm):
1) Ingest: validator passes and file accepted into staging within 24h of upload.
2) Quality: run our eval harness against 50 seed prompts; target exact-match/accuracy >= 0.78 (or mutually agreed metric).
3) Perf: 95th pct latency < 300ms for 512-token interactions under test load.
4) Security: no raw sensitive values in logs/audits; retention of staging files <= 30 days unless requested.
5) Ops: we can reproduce the flow end-to-end and hand over artifacts.

jordan: criteria look fair. procurement question: will there be any POC overage billing? need a short note for legal.

elaine: POC pricing: Redwood will cover hosted sandbox costs up to 10k generated tokens/day and 50 embedding units for the 2-week POC. Any overage will be billed at list rate but we can cap total at $500 for the POC unless you request higher limits — we'll send a POC addendum. :thumbsup:

sophia: security/controls quick answers for your team: SOC2 Type II in place, network logs and upload audit logs available, default retention for staging files is 30 days (can be shortened), KMS encryption at rest. For private installs we support customer-managed keys.

mike: next steps / action items:
- jordan: share an example sanitized CSV + S3 bucket name by EOD Friday.
- redwood (me + sophia): produce presigned PUT workflow, validation endpoint creds, and sample eval set by Monday.
- elaine: send the POC addendum and the short procurement note about overage cap.

jordan: will share sample CSV Friday EOD. thanks everyone. :raised_hands:

infra-bot: deploy started: staging-uploads-validator:v1.3 -> rolling update triggered (no downtime expected). :eyes:
